name: stm_castled_with_pawn_shield
description: Side to move has castled and their king has at least 2 pawns on adjacent files for protection.
source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'stm_castled_with_pawn_shield'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'Side to move has castled and their king has at least 2 pawns on adjacent files for protection.'

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    
    # Determine castled king position based on side to move
    if stm == chess.WHITE:
        king_sq_white = chess.G1 if board.has_kingside_castling_rights(chess.WHITE) and board.piece_at(chess.E1) else None
        king_sq_black = chess.C1 if board.has_queenside_castling_rights(chess.WHITE) and board.piece_at(chess.E1) else None
        # Actually check if king is on castled square
        king_on_g1 = board.piece_at(chess.G1) and board.piece_at(chess.G1).piece_type == chess.KING and board.piece_at(chess.G1).color == stm
        king_on_c1 = board.piece_at(chess.C1) and board.piece_at(chess.C1).piece_type == chess.KING and board.piece_at(chess.C1).color == stm
        king_file = chess.square_file(board.king(stm)) if board.king(stm) else None
        
        # King castled if on G1 or C1 (castled positions)
        castled = king_file == 6 or king_file == 2  # G file or C file
        
        if not castled:
            return False
        
        # Check for pawn shield (pawns on F2, G2, H2 for kingside or B2, C2, D2 for queenside)
        pawn_count = 0
        if king_file == 6:  # Kingside
            for f in [5, 6, 7]:  # F, G, H files
                for r in [0, 1]:  # Ranks 1, 2
                    sq = chess.square(f, r)
                    piece = board.piece_at(sq)
                    if piece and piece.piece_type == chess.PAWN and piece.color == stm:
                        pawn_count += 1
        else:  # Queenside
            for f in [1, 2, 3]:  # B, C, D files
                for r in [0, 1]:  # Ranks 1, 2
                    sq = chess.square(f, r)
                    piece = board.piece_at(sq)
                    if piece and piece.piece_type == chess.PAWN and piece.color == stm:
                        pawn_count += 1
        
        return pawn_count >= 2
    
    else:  # Black
        king_file = chess.square_file(board.king(stm)) if board.king(stm) else None
        castled = king_file == 6 or king_file == 2  # G file or C file
        
        if not castled:
            return False
        
        pawn_count = 0
        if king_file == 6:  # Kingside
            for f in [5, 6, 7]:  # F, G, H files
                for r in [6, 7]:  # Ranks 7, 8
                    sq = chess.square(f, r)
                    piece = board.piece_at(sq)
                    if piece and piece.piece_type == chess.PAWN and piece.color == stm:
                        pawn_count += 1
        else:  # Queenside
            for f in [1, 2, 3]:  # B, C, D files
                for r in [6, 7]:  # Ranks 7, 8
                    sq = chess.square(f, r)
                    piece = board.piece_at(sq)
                    if piece and piece.piece_type == chess.PAWN and piece.color == stm:
                        pawn_count += 1
        
        return pawn_count >= 2
